plugins.description: AI dev toolkit. Analyse a task, measure its blast radius, fix bugs, refactor safely, detect code/spec drift and keep the codebase clean — every code-touching step behind a human gate. Agent analyses and edits; the developer approves. Clean handover code: no comments, no invented identifier codes.
